product_one_liner.value: CyberCube provides cloud-based cyber-risk modeling and analytics for insurance organizations to support insurance placement, underwriting and portfolio risk management.
product_one_liner.notes: https://linkedin.com/company/18514105 describes CyberCube's cloud-based cyber-risk modeling and analytics platform for insurance organizations, including placement, underwriting and aggregation management.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the navigation reviewed at https://www.cybcube.com/, and https://www.cybcube.com/contact/ directs buyers to a specialist. The public-site review at https://apis.io/plans/cybercube/cybercube-plans-pricing also records no pricing page or published plans.

founded_year.notes: https://www.cybcube.com/about traces CyberCube's origins to 2015 as a Symantec division and separately dates its independent-company launch to 2018. The answer uses the business's 2015 origin.

eng_blog.notes: https://insights.cybcube.com/en/sharing-documents-a-graph-database-approach explains implementation of document sharing and access control; https://insights.cybcube.com/en/post_typeblogpostp1384 explains deploying Lambda functions and layers. Both identify author Emmanuel Thioux as an experienced software engineer, satisfying the two-post requirement.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation portal was identified from https://www.cybcube.com/. Its support page, https://www.cybcube.com/help/, explicitly places all user resources in secured accounts. https://apis.io/apis/cybercube/cyberconnect likewise identifies the API reference as login-gated.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The eight openings at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/cybcube comprise a data engineer, marketing and sales directors, two threat-intelligence roles, two actuaries and a security research engineer. None contains the required AI, ML or data-science title terms; the data-engineer role is expressly excluded by the question.

model_provider.notes: https://www.businessinsurance.com/insurtechs-seek-to-capitalize-on-ai-deployment reports CyberCube's CEO saying the company has employed OpenAI models and APIs since 2021. No particular model version is established.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the eight positions listed at https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/cybcube is an SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative or account executive. The Senior Director, (Re)Insurance Sales opening does not meet the specified title criteria.

launched_6mo.notes: The latest qualifying feature launch located was the May 5, 2026 benchmarking tool at https://www.cybcube.com/news/new-regional-risk-transfer-benchmarking, before the six-month window. Later entries reviewed at https://www.cybcube.com/news concern reports, an AI research framework, customers or partner programs rather than a CyberCube product or major-feature launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: https://www.cybcube.com/news/cybercube-announces-ceo-succession announces on February 9, 2026 that Chris Methven became CEO, succeeding Pascal Millaire, who became Senior Advisor. This falls within the requested twelve-month window.
